scientific_integrity: A complete mathematical proof and exact finite-case checker are supplied. The classical invertible-structure-matrix law, binary matrix corank law, and limiting product are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic-two finite fields and uniform labeled structure matrices are treated. The conditional singular limiting law fixes the field size. Some relevant general semilinear literature and the full motivating survey were not accessible in complete text; no absolute historical priority is claimed.
title: The full-matrix idempotent law for binary-characteristic evolution algebras
